description: Set the direction before you design the solution
whatIsIt: Vision for Change sets out why AVT matters, how it will improve patient care and staff experience and what good looks like in everyday clinical and administrative work.
userInsight: AVT landed best when it was framed as a clinical workflow and behaviour change, not a technology rollout
whyThisMatters:
Reduces confusion about what AVT is (and isn't) and protects trust in the change early.
 Prevents the programme being judged only on technology rather than the intended workflow improvement.
 Provides a consistent narrative across clinical, operational and admin audiences, reducing rumour-driven resistance.
quickRealityCheck:
Can staff describe AVT in one sentence? Does it reflect real pressures, not just programme goals?
 Are leaders saying the same thing consistently? Do people understand what will change in their day-to-day work?

whatGoodLooksLike.title: CLEAR AND COMPELLING
whatGoodLooksLike.body: Vision is simple, inspiring and focused on patient care, staff experience and better ways of working.

whatGoodLooksLike.title: UNDERSTOOD AND SHARED
whatGoodLooksLike.body: Staff at all levels can explain in their own words why AVT matters and what will change..

whatGoodLooksLike.title: CONSISTENTLY COMMUNICATED
whatGoodLooksLike.body: Leaders reinforce the vision regularly and use it to guide decisions and priorities.

whatGoodLooksLike.title: GROUNDED IN REAL SITUATIONS
whatGoodLooksLike.body: Vision reflects the day-to-day challenges teams face and the improvements AVT will bring.

whatGoodLooksLike.title: GUIDES ACTIONS
whatGoodLooksLike.body: Vision helps teams make choices, solve problems and stay focused on what matters

risksIfYouDont.title: SEEN AS A TECHNOLOGY ROLLOUT
risksIfYouDont.body: Focus stays on the tool rather than the workflow and behaviour change.

risksIfYouDont.title: CONFUSION AND MIXED MESSAGES
risksIfYouDont.body: Different teams hear different things, leading to uncertainty about the reason AVT is being introduced.

risksIfYouDont.title: LOW ENGAGEMENT AND RESISTANCE
risksIfYouDont.body: Staff don't see the relevance to their day-to-day work and are less likely to adopt AVT.

risksIfYouDont.title: INCONSISTENT ADOPTION
risksIfYouDont.body: Without a shared vision, use will vary widely across teams and services.

risksIfYouDont.title: BENEFITS NOT REALISED
risksIfYouDont.body: Without a clear direction, efforts drift and the value of AVT is not achieved
